title: Image-bound externally declared binary validity v1
description:
Runtime also rejects duplicate keys, non-UTF-8 input, noncanonical integer lexemes (including .0 or exponent forms), nonfinite binary64 conversions, and cross-field violations not expressible here. Input JSON is bounded to 256 KiB. SHA-256 binds the image and the adjacent validity.pgm bytes, not the truthfulness of the mask producer. Runtime requires dimensions matching the image/plan (at most 200,000,000 pixels), exact P5
WIDTH HEIGHT
1
 header, and exactly WIDTH*HEIGHT binary samples 0 or 1 with no trailing bytes. A black image sample can be valid.
